item.title: Kubernetes Platform Management Software Stress Testing Plan
item.description: Kubernetes platform management software runs on Kubernetes and is used to manage the resource objects running on Kubernetes. 1. Testing Approach Test the management capability of the platform software under a given load and a given cluster scale, not the management capability of Kubernetes. The platform software’s management capability is mainly reflected in the ability to create, read, update, and delete workloads and PVs through the UI, and to view the monitoring and logs of workloads directly in the UI.
